question.text: A portfolio has annualized return 10.5%, Rf = 5.5%, SD = 6.5%. What is the Sharpe Ratio?

explanation.text: The Logic: Sharpe = (Rp - Rf) / SD = (10.5 - 5.5) / 6.5 = 5/6.5 = 0.7692. The Trap: 1.6154 uses wrong SD; 0.05 divides differently. Cross-Exam Context: XV, XVII, X-A all test; XXI-B tests fluency.
